penalties_applied.name: b2c_at_scale_needed
penalties_applied.reason: MacBook power-user tool is a consumer product; unit economics require thousands of paying individual users to be meaningful.

rationale: While the HN complaint pattern is real, this is a consumer indie-app play with low WTP (users expect free or $5 one-time), no clear B2B angle, and requires B2C scale. The B2C penalty correctly reflects that the revenue model is fragile at small user counts.
